strict._help: Strict mode: Kronos calls only when ALL samples agree (confidence 100%), the call is a reversal (opposite of the last candle), and the predicted move is at least this big (in % of price). Cutoffs = 90th percentile of Kronos's predicted move sizes on the FIRST 2/3 of the backtest only.

config._help: Night autopilot: practice bets (fake money) on Strict signals during these Eastern-time hours, at Kalshi's real price, only if that side costs max_price or less. Edit and push to change.
